opening_message:
Ticket 1: Ashley Roberts (employee ID E016) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E016.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Ashley Roberts (E016), Analyst, full-time employee. Requested write access to Payroll. Full-time employees can have up to write; role does not own Payroll, so admin is not applicable. Requested level (write) is at the allowed maximum — recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E016: contractor with basic security training. Contractors with basic training max out at read; write is not permitted. Recommend read for Payroll (cap to maximum).
reason: HR record (Note 1) identifies Ashley Roberts (E016) as a full-time Analyst. Per policy, full-time employees may have up to write; admin is only available if the employee's role owns the system, and Analyst does not own Payroll. The requested level (write) is at the allowed maximum for this employee, so write is granted. Note: Security's record (Note 2) conflicts on employment type (contractor with basic training), but the HR employment record is authoritative; under the HR facts, write is permitted.
